headline: Two strong weeks banked, but Gibraltar is still out of reach
body:
Your last two full weeks — 65.6 and 68.8 miles — are real training, a big step up from the 10 and 16 mile weeks and the zero week in mid-August. Hold that shape. On distance, you're partway there: 27.7 miles is your longest ride, under half of 62, so the coastal route needs your long ride pushed toward 40 and then 50 in the next three weekends. On climbing, be plain about it — your best single ride is 1,819 ft, and Gibraltar alone gains 2,551 ft after 30 miles of riding. Today, the training points to the 100 KM Coastal.

Wednesday hits 99°F, so make it a short early spin or nothing. Thursday's 87 with 18 mph gusts suits an easy Mesa or Goleta Beach hour. Friday through Sunday sit at 77–79 with light wind: Saturday for the foothill climbs, Sunday for your longest ride yet. Monday and Tuesday, calm and mid-70s, spin easy.
